title: Aggrega Wasm Policy Validator Socket
description: The JSON wire shapes the policy-validator.wasm plugin socket consumes (PolicyValidatorInput) and emits (PolicyValidatorOutput). The policy validator runs in Step 4 of the compilation pipeline; a fail verdict halts the build with a build-time diagnostic. The two wire shapes are co-canonical with the Go types in aggrega-cli/internal/compiler/analyzer/wasm_types.go and with each per-language PDK's mirror; per-language round-trip tests catch drift.

PolicyValidatorInput.description: The payload Step 4 hands to the policy-validator socket: a per-node policy projection of the IR graph plus the precalculated routing paths the analyzer enumerates alongside.

precalculated_paths.description: Routing paths the analyzer pre-enumerated so policies can reason about reachability without re-walking the graph.

PolicyValidatorOutput.description: The response shape the policy-validator plugin emits: one PolicyResult per evaluated rule. An empty results array signals 'no policy rules ran' (distinct from 'all rules passed', which is an array of pass=true results).

results.description: One verdict per evaluated policy rule.

PolicyGraph.description: The IR subset exposed to the policy validator: per-node component identity, version, labels, and Feature attachments, plus the per-edge routing identity and edge-atomicity marker.

nodes.description: Nodes keyed by absolute node ID.

edges.description: Edges in author order; the cross-package determinism contract preserves this ordering across runs of identical input.

PolicyNode.description: The per-node projection exposed to the policy validator. Narrower than the full IR node surface: boundary path, subsystem path, sync wave, the three annotation buckets, provides, and self-inject are not exposed. Constraining the surface matches the principle-of-least-authority discipline that applies to every Wasm plugin socket.

component.description: The catalog component URI the node resolves against; policies scope rules by component type.

resolved_version.description: The exact Semantic Version of the Component the resolver pinned for this node; policies can express version-floor or version-pin rules.

labels.description: The node's catalog and authoring labels. The vocabulary that compliance, AI ontology, and topological-purity policy use.

features.description: Per-instance Feature attachment map (instance name to attachment entry). Policies can enforce required-feature and forbidden-feature rules.

PolicyEdge.description: The per-edge projection exposed to the policy validator. Source, target, and socket carry routing identity. OriginFeature distinguishes Component-authored edges from Feature-authored edges so policies can express rules sensitive to which authoring surface introduced the edge.

socket.description: The usesSchema category this edge belongs to (e.g., 'databases', 'tools').

origin_feature.description: The originating Feature instance name when this edge was autonomously declared by a Feature; empty for Component-authored edges.

PrecalculatedPath.description: One pre-enumerated routing path the analyzer materializes so policy rules can reason about reachability without re-walking the graph.

path_id.description: Stable identifier for this path; deterministic across runs of identical input.

nodes.description: Ordered sequence of node IDs the path traverses, from source to terminal.

attached_features.description: Alphabetically sorted union of Feature type URIs attached to any node along the path. Set-membership semantics: a Feature appears once even if multiple nodes carry it. Empty when no node along the path carries any Feature attachment.

PolicyFeatureEntry.description: A Feature attachment exposed to the policy validator: the Feature type URI, the resolved version, and the operational payloads. Mirrors the per-feature shape policies need without exposing internal provenance metadata.

type.description: The URI of the catalog Feature this attachment instantiates.

resolved_version.description: The exact Semantic Version of the Feature the resolver pinned for this attachment.

values.description: The operational configuration payload for the Feature attachment.

infra.description: Physical sizing overrides targeting this Feature attachment.

origin.description: Distinguishes Feature attachments authored in a features: block ('explicit') from synthetic attachments produced by the annotation-driven expansion pass ('annotation').

PolicyResult.description: One rule's verdict. Pass=false halts the build with Message surfaced as a build-time diagnostic; Pass=true is informational and does not affect build outcome.

pass.description: True when the rule's verdict permits the build to proceed; false halts the build.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic. Always populated. On pass=false the message surfaces as the build-time error; on pass=true it is informational.
